Third-party scripts in this folder
==================================

gsap.min.js, ScrollTrigger.min.js, SplitText.min.js  (GSAP 3.13.0)
  Copyright GreenSock / Webflow. Free to use, including commercially,
  under the GSAP Standard "No Charge" License: https://gsap.com/standard-license

lenis.min.js  (Lenis 1.3.4)
  Copyright darkroom.engineering. MIT License: https://github.com/darkroomengineering/lenis

They are kept here, rather than loaded from a CDN, so the site works
offline, never breaks if a CDN changes, and makes no third-party requests
on page load.
